# Awaken Spiritual Store

> Awaken Spiritual Store is a spiritual and metaphysical shop in downtown Collingwood, Ontario, Canada. Opened in June 2018 by owner Penny, it offers crystals, tarot and oracle cards, books, incense, jewelry, smudging tools, and spiritual healing support in a calm, welcoming community space.

Awaken is known locally as an inclusive place to learn, heal, grow, and shine. Customers can browse crystals and spiritual tools, explore open oracle decks, and ask staff for guidance. Readings and other in-store services may be available — ask in store for the current schedule.

- Legal name / brand: Awaken Spiritual Store
- Address: 207 Hurontario St Unit 2, Collingwood, ON L9Y 2M1, Canada
- Phone: +1-705-293-8811
- Email: awakenspiritualstore@gmail.com
- Hours: Tuesday–Saturday 12:00–5:00 pm; Sunday CLOSED; Monday CLOSED
- Website: https://awaken.store/

- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/awakenspiritualstore/
- Area served: Collingwood and South Georgian Bay, Ontario
